Job Location: Garki, Abuja (FCT)

Job Description


	Positioning patients and equipment, explaining the procedures, and ensuring patients&#39; comfort.
	Interact with patients to offer them psychological support and reassurance.
	Set accurate radiation levels in accordance with established standards and obtain patient consent prior to diagnostic imaging to fulfill legal requirements.
	Carry out conventional &amp; specials procedures e.g HSG, RUG, Barium etc.
	Operate CT scanners, MRI, X-rays, machines etc. to obtain radiographic images of patient.
	Evaluate patient condition prior to radiotherapy to determine the suitable radiographic technique for treatment.
	Accurately performs diagnostic imaging to obtain clear, usable images.
	Inserting commands and data into the computer to document and specify the scan sequences and monitoring the video display to adjust the density or contrast.
	Monitor patients during examinations, ensuring their safety, and following procedures to prevent unnecessary exposure to radiation.
	Ensure that all names of conducted studies are move to work area.
	Ensure that all acquired images are uploaded onto the viewing platform.
	Ensure compliance with established safety regulations and procedures when operating radiation equipment in order to prevent ill-exposure to ionizing radiation.
	Producing diagnostic images, reporting important information to the Physician, and updating patients&#39; records on PACS.
	Follow all radiology health and safety rules and report any possible hazards to the Radiologist and Branch Operations Manager
	Keep and / or retrieve departmental copies of patient test reports.

	First Degree in Radiography
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in similar job role
	A license to practice Radiography.
	Candidate must be able to carry out specials procedures.
	Observes confidentiality both with patient information and co-workers.
	Ability to connect with several types of patients.
	Attention to detail and skill in proper patient identification.
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills, empathy, and compassion.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Sonographer",
  "description": "Echo-Scan Services Limited to ensure global best practice delivery of diagnostic services in Nigeriaproviding wide range of diagnostic services, including pathology and molecular diagnostics, genetics testing and radiology to patients.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sonographer&nbsp;

Job Location: Akowonjo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities


	Operate ultrasound imaging equipment to produce clear and informative diagnostic images.
	Review images to ensure quality and identify any abnormalities that may require further investigation.
	Prepare patients for ultrasound, X-rays &amp; ECG examinations by explaining procedures, positioning them comfortably, and applying ultrasound gel.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Supply Chain Manager",
  "description": "Bell OIl and Gas Limited is a leading indigenous oilfield services company, dedicated to consistently proffering solutions, driving local content development and capacity building in Nigeria. We offer an extensive range of high quality professional services to clients across the facets of &nbsp;oil and gas industry and other industries.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Supply Chain Manager

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports to: GM &ndash; Supply Chain and Business Development

Job Description


	To ensure the purchase of the right items at the right price, from the right source, and delivered in the right quality, right quantity, and on time to clients.


Responsibilities


	Develop and execute the company&rsquo;s supply chain strategy aligned with business objectives.
	Lead procurement activities from sourcing and RFQ issuance through bid evaluation, negotiation, purchase order placement, and contract administration.
	Build and manage strategic relationships with OEMs, manufacturers, distributors, freight forwarders, and logistics partners.
	Ensure timely delivery of materials and equipment to meet project schedules and customer commitments.
	Manage international sourcing, importation, customs clearance, shipping, and local logistics.
	Negotiate commercial terms to improve cost, quality, delivery, and supplier performance.
	Establish supplier performance measurement and continuous improvement initiatives.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, NCDMB requirements, procurement regulations, and corporate governance standards.
	Collaborate with Business Development, Sales, Finance, and Operations to support tenders and project execution.
	Identify supply chain risks and develop mitigation strategies.
	Lead, mentor, and develop the supply chain team.
	Oversee the implementation of the Supply Chain Process to meet company&rsquo;s objectives.
	Work within established Supply Chain Procedures for requisition, processing, validation, delivery and invoicing.
